title: Plugins
subtitle: Manage generated/A declarative tools and generated/B code tools (read-only/retrieval tools built live in chat) and skill toggles. No black box — inspect the manifest/source, enable/disable, uninstall. B tools require explicit trust before they execute (every call still prompts approval).
empty: No plugins yet. Ask the assistant in chat to build a tool (e.g. "make a tool that reads a file"); it will appear here.

builtin.name: Built-in tools
builtin.desc: Built-in statically bundled tools, cannot be uninstalled

removeConfirm: Uninstall this plugin? The tool will be unregistered from the registry and the manifest/source deleted. This cannot be undone.
untrustedHint: Untrusted — calling it only returns a hint. Click the shield on the right to trust and enable execution
trustConfirm: Trust this code tool? Once trusted, the handler source below will execute (in a vm sandbox, whitelist read-only actions only, every call still prompts approval). Review the source for malicious behavior first.
